claims.claim: CULIANCE describes itself as a debit card network built for credit unions, connecting accounts to ATMs, retail POS and online merchants nationwide (US only).
claims.quote: CULIANCE is a debit card network built for credit unions. It connects your credit union account to ATMs, retail stores, and online merchants nationwide
claims.title: FAQs — CULIANCE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Cardholder-facing site; no participant (credit union) count published.

claims.claim: CULIANCE is owned and operated by FIS, not Velera: the culiance.com footer carries an FIS copyright and the site's 'Credit Unions' link goes to fisglobal.com/products/culiance.
claims.quote: © FIS and/or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
claims.title: CULIANCE Network — Surcharge-Free ATMs for Credit Union Members
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Contradicts the assignment context that CULIANCE is 'formerly CO-OP network, part of Velera'. Velera's networks are branded CO-OP ATM Network and Pay Network (see contradictions). No ownership change since 2020 found on public pages; HQ not stated on culiance.com (FIS lists 347 Riverside Ave., Jacksonville, FL).

claims.claim: CULIANCE claims over 80,000 surcharge-free ATMs nationwide (n.d., site version stamped July 2026).
claims.quote: The CULIANCE ®  Network connects your debit card to over 80,000 surcharge-free ATMs nationwide.
claims.title: CULIANCE Network — Surcharge-Free ATMs for Credit Union Members
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Footnote on the same page: 'Not all credit unions participate in the surcharge-free programs.' Same 80,000 figure repeated on fisglobal.com/products/culiance, so no discrepancy between the two pages.

claims.claim: CULIANCE claims acceptance at more than 2 million US retail POS locations plus online merchants; no transaction or volume figures are published.
claims.quote: At more than 80,000 surcharge-free ATMs, over 2 million retail POS locations, and online wherever CULIANCE debit is accepted.
claims.title: FAQs — CULIANCE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: No card counts, transaction counts or dollar volume on any fetched page.

claims.claim: CULIANCE is a PIN-debit network that also supports PIN-less (card-not-present) debit, i.e. it is not signature/dual-message only.
claims.quote: Yes. CULIANCE supports online debit transactions without requiring a PIN or signature at checkout.
claims.title: FAQs — CULIANCE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Single- vs dual-message capability is not stated explicitly; PIN-less debit implies single-message CNP routing.

claims.claim: Velera's ATM network is branded CO-OP ATM Network with 40,000+ ATMs, and its debit POS network is branded Pay Network; neither page mentions CULIANCE.
claims.quote: Access to 40,000+ ATMs Across the Country

claims.claim: culiance.com is a cardholder-facing site (Home, ATM Locator, Credit Unions, FAQs); the only partner-facing surface is the outbound link to FIS's product page, and questions are routed to the member's credit union.

claims.claim: The published route for a credit union to join CULIANCE is an FIS sales enquiry ('Connect with sales'); no application steps, certification stages, timelines or fees are published.

claims.label: Vendor
